name: IFTTT
summary: No-code service linking 1,000+ apps and devices through simple trigger-action applets.
description: IFTTT connects more than 1,000 services, including Google apps, webhooks, Discord, Slack and smart home devices, through applets that run an action when a trigger fires. It is aimed at individuals and small businesses rather than complex enterprise workflows. A free plan allows using published applets; paid tiers add multi-step and filter features.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Free, then 1.89 €/mo (Starter, billed annually; 22.69 €/year). Pro is 4.97 €/mo billed annually and Pro+ 12.66 €/mo billed annually.

howToUse.title: Open IFTTT
howToUse.description: Open IFTTT and choose Get started or Start building.

howToUse.title: Connect a trigger to an action
howToUse.description: Create an applet that connects services. Choose a trigger, pick an action, and customize it so the action runs when the trigger fires. Services include Google apps, webhooks, Discord, Slack, and smart home devices, among more than 1,000.

howToUse.title: Enable a published applet
howToUse.description: Enable a published applet when you want one that already exists. The free plan allows using published applets.

howToUse.title: Move to a paid tier for longer applets
howToUse.description: Upgrade to a paid tier when you need multi-step applets or filters. IFTTT is aimed at individuals and small businesses.

features_fr: Service sans code reliant plus de 1 000 applications et appareils via de simples applets à déclenchement.

IFTTT connecte plus de 1 000 services, notamment les applications Google, les webhooks, Discord, Slack et les appareils domestiques intelligents, via des applets qui exécutent une action lorsqu'un déclencheur se déclenche.
Il s'adresse aux particuliers et aux petites entreprises plutôt qu'aux flux de travail complexes des entreprises.
Un forfait gratuit permet d'utiliser des applets publiées ; les forfaits payants ajoutent des fonctions multi-étapes et de filtrage.
